summary: M0 model-only verdict: MONITOR @ 1.00. The majority of sign-ins are consistent with the faculty member travelling abroad: repeated successful logins from Portugal via the corporate VPN appliance, same device (LT-3104), across mail and LMS, with no MFA prompts. A single outlier exists—a successful login from Turkey (Manisa, Turkcell) earlier on 2026-10-15 with no VPN, no device ID, and no MFA prompt. No mail events or subsequent activity from that IP are present. This anomalous single sign-in is a weak unexplained signal that does not by itself confirm account takeover, but cannot be fully explained from the available data. Monitoring is appropriate; contain is premature without evidence of malicious activity, and escalation is not required because there is no apparent exposure or critical evidence gap beyond this single anomaly.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
